Hi Vanessa / Laura —

Thanks again for sponsoring the East Coast Roadshow last week. Attached is our preliminary summary (brightline-report-summary.xlsx) and the full attendee export (eastcoast-attendees-raw.csv). Quick highlights:
- Total on-site registrations: 2,120
- Checked-in attendees: 1,430
- Leads attributed to Redwood (badge-scan + form opt-ins): 184 (we flagged these as "Redwood-sponsored leads")
- Leads with company domains matching FinStart listed as 14

We also attached the invoice for sponsorship (redwood-sponsor-invoice.pdf). Let us know if you want the attendee export filtered by session or badge-scan times.

Apologies for the rough spreadsheet — we can run additional dedupe logic if you prefer a unique-email basis.

Best,
Amy Lee
Operations Manager
BrightLine Events

Subject: Re: East Coast Roadshow — preliminary attendee reconciliation and report

Thanks Amy — quick read-through and a couple of immediate questions before we reconcile with HubSpot:

1) Your file has 184 "Redwood-sponsored leads" but our CRM shows 127 new Hot/Marketing qualified leads attributed to the event. Can you confirm the attribution logic you used (badge-scan vs form opt-in vs business card drop)?

2) We see 6 leads from FinStart in our system, not 14. Can you attach the raw email column and any phone numbers so we can dedupe on email+phone?

3) I noticed a cluster of badge-scan timestamps around 11:30am — did you import duplicate scans for badge reprints? If so we need to understand how you count unique visitors vs scan events.

Action items: please share a deduped export (email, company, phone, scan-timestamp, opt-in flag). Marcus / Laura — I'll rely on you to map these to HubSpot contact records and summarize variance (count, pipeline stage, expected ARR) by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Amy Lee <amy@brightline.events>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:43:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: East Coast Roadshow — preliminary attendee reconciliation and report

Hi Vanessa / team —

Thanks for the quick questions. We dug in and here is what we found:
- The 184 count is based on badge-scan OR session form opt-in. We did not dedupe by email in the preliminary sheet.
- There were ~120 badge reprints between 11:15-11:45 (vendor reported a badge printer error) which explains the scan cluster — those reprints generated duplicate scan events for some attendees.
- I attached an updated export with email + phone columns and a "scan_count" column (eastcoast-attendees-raw.csv — column header: email,phone,company,scan_timestamp,scan_count,opt_in).

We're happy to run a dedupe pass grouping by email or by (email+phone) — tell us which you prefer and we'll return a deduped file.

Also FYI: we have one sponsor contact (events@acme.com) disputing two VIP leads listed as "Qualified" — they want to confirm the company match before we finalize partner credits.

Best,
Amy
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:06:00 -05:00
Subject: Internal: first-pass mapping to HubSpot (do not forward)

Vanessa / Laura / Tessa —

I pulled the attached export and ran a quick dedupe by email. Initial results:
- Dedupe by email reduces the 184 -> 139 unique emails.
- Of those 139, 42 matched existing HubSpot contacts (merge suggested); 97 are new contacts.
- Pipeline lift estimate (conservative): 12 MQL -> 3 SAL -> 1 SQL; estimated influenced ARR: $68k (pipeline only).

Notes:
- Several FinStart contacts are on personal gmail addresses which made domain matching unreliable. I flagged those (emails included) and will reach out to Sara Nguyen to confirm company mappings.
- For Acme's VIP dispute: two entries have the same email but different company names (one lists Acme, one lists Acme Systems) — suggest we mirror Amy's final dedupe output.

I'll prepare a reconciliation table (email, orig_scan_count, deduped_flag, hs_contact_id, hs_url) and drop into the Drive link by EOD Thursday.

-Marcus
Senior Growth Operations Analyst
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Amy Lee <amy@brightline.events>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:30:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: East Coast Roadshow — attribution reconciliation & next steps

Amy — thanks for the updated export. Proposed reconciliation rules from our side (please confirm):
1) Primary dedupe key: email (if email blank, fallback to phone + name similarity).
2) If email maps to multiple company names, we will use the company name from the contact with a verified company domain; if both are ambiguous, mark for manual review.
3) Badge-scan duplicates (scan_count >1) will be collapsed to unique email unless opt_in flag indicates distinct consent events.

If BrightLine can return a deduped CSV following rule #1 by Thursday EOD, we'll accept that as the canonical list for attribution and finalize counts. We'll also share the HubSpot merge/merge-IDs and a short reconciliation sheet (email, final_company, hs_contact_id, attribution) so sponsors can see the lineage.

Action owners: BrightLine (Amy) — produce deduped CSV; Redwood (Marcus) — import and surface variance report; Redwood (Vanessa) — confirm sponsor credits once variance resolved.

Thanks — aiming to close this before invoice net-30 processing.

Vanessa
From: Amy Lee <amy@brightline.events>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, events@acme.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: East Coast Roadshow — attribution reconciliation & ticketing anomaly

Vanessa / team —

Attached is the deduped file per your primary-key rule (eastcoast-attendees-deduped.csv) and an updated summary in the Drive link (https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-eastcoast-report). Final agreed counts:
- BrightLine deduped leads attributed to Redwood: 138
- Redwood HubSpot new contacts created after import: 97 (matches Marcus' import numbers)
- FinStart final matched contacts: 5 (Sara Nguyen confirmed through reply below)
- Acme VIP disputed leads: 0 after manual review (they were duplicate badge-scan events from the reprints)

We have marked final column "attribution_confirmed" = true for all rows we believe should count toward sponsor attribution. Please confirm by Friday so we can close the event reconciliation and process sponsor credits.

Thanks again — apologies for the earlier noise, and let me know if you want BrightLine to run the HubSpot matching on our end in future events (we can provide a hashed-email match to preserve PII).

Best,
Amy Lee
